bootstrap_t_interval.quantile_order: interval inversion reverses quantile order; upper endpoint uses the lower-tail 2.5th percentile
bootstrap_t_interval.independent_unit: seed; resample each seed with its complete paired speed/target/period cluster

degenerate_variance.zero_observed_seed_variance: NOT_EVALUABLE_ZERO_OBSERVED_VARIANCE; point estimate retained, interval endpoints null
degenerate_variance.any_zero_standard_error_bootstrap_replic: NOT_EVALUABLE_DEGENERATE_BOOTSTRAP_VARIANCE; report degenerate and non-finite counts, interval endpoints null
degenerate_variance.interpretation: zero observed or resampled variance is not reported as zero uncertainty; invalid synthetic Monte Carlo datasets make the audit inconclusive rather than being dropped

primary_position.contrast: M1_CAUSAL_PREFIX minus FIXED_D3; negative favors M1
primary_position.estimand: equal-weight mean of per-speed paired common-success RMSE differences within seed
primary_position.unapproved_support_status: NOT_EVALUABLE_MINIMUM_COMMON_SUPPORT_UNAPPROVED; descriptive estimate is separate and excluded from confirmatory inference
primary_position.scheme_a: two-sided 95% interval upper endpoint < 0 AND seed-level point estimate <= -MDE

detection_and_joint_gate.detection_endpoint: M1 minus FIXED_D3 correct-detection coverage difference in percentage points over all planned target-period opportunities
detection_and_joint_gate.success_rule: two-sided seed-cluster 95% interval lower endpoint > -approved margin
detection_and_joint_gate.joint_rule: selected position rule AND detection-coverage noninferiority; include track-coverage noninferiority only if explicitly selected with an approved margin
detection_and_joint_gate.missing_opportunity_rule: preserve planned coverage denominator; missing required record makes that seed position endpoint not evaluable
detection_and_joint_gate.method_failure_rule: current-period zero correction for estimator failure remains in all planned opportunity denominators; no method/reference substitution

h0.primary_endpoint: seed-any-event: proportion of independent H0 seeds with at least one false postfilter Detection in ten valid beam-50 periods
h0.false_track_guard_endpoint: proportion of independent H0 seeds with at least one unique false confirmed TrackManager track ID
h0.false_track_counting_unit: unique false confirmed track IDs per seed; repeated periods are not independent tracks
h0.event_rate_interval: exact Clopper-Pearson; report two-sided 95% interval and one-sided exact 95% upper bound
h0.period_event_fraction: seed-level clustered descriptive endpoint; do not treat periods as independent seeds
h0.scope_limit: beam-50 ten-period task endpoint; not full-system Pfa

missing_data_and_multiplicity.missing_or_invalid_seed: retain planned registry; no replacement and no silent denominator reduction; incomplete confirmatory endpoint
missing_data_and_multiplicity.missing_truth_or_method_reference: not evaluable under the frozen method-specific rule; no implicit fallback
missing_data_and_multiplicity.ties: strict superiority upper endpoint < boundary; noninferiority lower endpoint > -margin; equality fails
missing_data_and_multiplicity.secondary_speed_tests: Holm correction across three speeds if inferential p-values are reported

historical_support_sensitivity.historical_estimators: V3.3 full-case batch estimators; not V4 causal-prefix outcomes
historical_support_sensitivity.interpretation: all three floors retain the same historical units; this slice cannot distinguish the candidates and does not select a floor or predict V4 coverage

unresolved_user_choices: track protection gate or descriptive-only policy
